limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the prefix and suffix checks but evaluated the post-shift window, asserting match one clock earlier than the fix that registers both checks from the pre-shift window.
Changing the shift register's reset value from all zeros to all ones suppressed startup matches that the zero-filled design would report.

The testbench checked the just-shifted window and required nine samples after reset, so its exhaustive pass confirmed the rewrite's assumptions rather than checking the required timing and startup behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: Including a rejected cleanup command prevented both the edit and the simulation from running, forcing the agent to resubmit them.
